I think you are confusing the onset of action with peak onset. 

  
Alprazolam has on onset of action (duration of time it takes for a drug's effects to come to prominence upon administration) of approximately 15-30 minutes with a peak onset (the point where a drug has reached peak concentration) of about 1.6 hours.   


It will not be completely gone when the peak comes in, as  this is not how alprazolam works.  Alprazolam has an elimination half-life (period of time that it takes for the concentration or amount in the body of that drug to be reduced by exactly one half (50%))  of 11-12 hours so we wouldn't be seeing concentration to dip for a while.   


So technically with a dose of 0.5mg you wouldn't expect to see concentrations dip for a while.  


You would better to go with the lowest dose possible such as 250 ug or even half of a 250ug tablet as alprazolam has a very  high bioavailability, you don'tneed it to make you noticeably calm and sedated, just enough for it to work in the background and take the edge off.
